assertion_independence: No added assertion simply checks an echo of a value supplied to the code under test. Snapshots at lines 288,321,431 are independently read from the repository after the peer write and before rollback; lines 379,380,432,433 observe filesystem/git state rather than returned input values. Synchronization and injection checks are distinguished above.

assertion_review.failure_condition: Injection precondition fails if promotion has not actually written the comment before the peer edit.
Fixture check fails if the injected peer operation makes no repository change; this does not itself guard rollback.
The raises context fails if the forced profile/store/commit refusal is swallowed.
Fails if promotion never reaches the injected peer edit.
Fails if stale rollback overwrites any independently captured peer digest/version/index/status; reversing the first repair does so.
Fails if ownership refusal loses its preservation explanation.
Fails if a refusal falsely reports restoration after preserving a peer edit.
The raises context fails if the forced profile refusal is swallowed.
Fails if rollback removes the independent state edit made before the comment writer; the first source reversal does so.
Synchronization check fails if the staging injection never starts the editor within the bound.
Synchronization check fails if the editor never reaches its lock attempt.
The raises context fails if an actual staging refusal is swallowed or replaced with a different error.
Fails if the editor remains blocked after the promotion finishes.
Fails on an exception in the concurrent editor, preventing a dead writer from being counted as preserved.
Fails if rollback erases the peer heading in the working file; the first source reversal does so.
Fails if rollback erases the peer heading in the independently read git index; the first source reversal does so.
The raises context fails if the merged peer case refuses before reaching the actual staging failure or swallows it.
Fails if failed-commit rollback changes the independently captured merged plan bytes; reversing the final correction does so.
Fails if the independent peer comment is erased, including if both stored and captured images accidentally lack it.
Fails if rollback leaves the originally clean plan index staged.

findings.text: non-blocking: The new snapshot wrapper duplicates landing-comment construction (ID, escaped body, append, initial status and versioned rendering) from reckon/crew/promotion_scope.py:1450-1457,1481-1488,1566-1585 instead of extending that owner to expose its intended write. The ownership check now depends on two implementations staying identical; a later valid writer change can be refused as foreign content. The wrapper calls the owner afterward but its prediction duplicates the capability. Consolidate the pure transformation in the existing owner; current regression and importer evidence shows no present behavioral failure, so this does not block landing.

FINDING reckon/crew/promotion.py:2006 non-blocking: The new snapshot wrapper duplicates landing-comment construction (ID, escaped body, append, initial status and versioned rendering) from reckon/crew/promotion_scope.py:1450-1457,1481-1488,1566-1585 instead of extending that owner to expose its intended write. The ownership check now depends on two implementations staying identical; a later valid writer change can be refused as foreign content. The wrapper calls the owner afterward but its prediction duplicates the capability. Consolidate the pure transformation in the existing owner; current regression and importer evidence shows no present behavioral failure, so this does not block landing.

reuse_search.added_definitions: require_owned_content and require_owned_index extend the existing snapshot owner; restore_owned extends its restoration with the existing git-index retry owner; _commit_with_plan_snapshot wraps the existing commit owner and reuses store merge admission; _record_comment_with_snapshot wraps the writer but duplicates its payload derivation; added test and injection functions extend the existing regression test owner.
